newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Procter to sell Australia, NZ units.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Procter to sell Australia, NZ units.

text.p: Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc said on Wednesday it had agreed to acquire the prescription pharmaceutical business of Procter & Gamble Phamaceuticals Pty Ltd in Australia and New Zealand.

The companies said in a joint statement products included in the purchase are Dantrium, a muscle relaxant, Didronel, a treatment for Paget's disease, Didrocal, indicated for postmenopausal osteoporosis, and Macrodantin, treatment for urinary tract infections.
The sale was subject to Australian government approval.
In the interim, Pharmacia & Upjohn would provide marketing and technical support for the full range of Procter & Gamble pharmaceuticals products in Australia.
Pharmacia & Upjohn marketing company president Rod Unsworth said in the statement the sale was a logical and desirable acquisition for Pharmacia & Upjohn.
Both companies declined to nominate the purchase price.
